name: Zombie Puke
source:
a girl wakes up with a body she doesn't remember, a brain that doesn't work, and a world she can't even process.

or, alternately: a game about zombies and puke.

[From [url=https://briarbells.itch.io/zombie-puke]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一个女孩醒来时发现她的身体已经不记得了，她的大脑已经无法工作，她甚至无法处理这个世界。

或者，或者：关于僵尸和呕吐物的游戏。

[来自[url=https://briarbells.itch.io/zombie-puke]itch.io[/url]]
